limitations: This is internal AI review by the named reviewer agent, separate from the implementation agent. It is not human mathematical review, organizer review, a cryptographic signature, upstream approval, acceptance, a score or an award.
This review approves only the content bound by content_sha256 and the stated five checks. Any covered-content change requires fresh review; source line endings follow the coordinator hash function.

The reviewer did not independently invoke Tectonic or verify byte-identical PDF rebuilding with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=0 in this final stage. PDF/TeX content and exact-PDF visual correspondence were checked. The release coordinator must perform the separate full publication validation, including deterministic TeX rebuild.

The release coordinator retains responsibility for fresh upstream duplicate checks, permissions, publication, CI and upstream maintainer review. No network publication or repository permission changes were performed.

The proof checks rely on the installed Lean toolchain, its kernel and implementation. The toolchain binary provenance and arbitrary third-party build sandbox security were not independently re-audited here.
